text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Visitors slam bus and taxi drivers for cheating. Tourists interviewed in Malta complain about over-charging.

- Government considering measures for better road discipline. Malta, with a population of 365,000, has 195,000 registered vehicles, with 80,000 new cars having been introduced on the congested roads in 10 years.
- Five people arrested in Romania after drugs container found in Malta. The container, with 7.5 tonnes of cannabis, was found in Malta Freeport in transit from Singapore to Romania.
- Opposition leader Alfred Sant on steep rise in taxes over 10 years. He reiterates promise that a future Labour government will remove VAT.
